motifcode.execution: This repository's build: 0.4.0 with the Motif-3 harness optimizations. `motif "<task>"` one-shot, in the directory the runner gives it; a task ends only by a `done` call, which is challenged once and must be confirmed; a turn without an action is handed back; turn limit from the manifest (100); the feedback round is `motif --continue-from <journal> "<test output>"`.
motifcode.tools: done, bash (120 s per command unless the model sets another), read, write, apply_patch, term, skill, task; no MCP servers, no web tools.
motifcode.context: Frozen tool order; the model's reasoning is sent back every turn; compaction at 75% of the 262,144-token window; the output cap per step from the manifest, temperature 1.0 and top_p 0.95 sent with every request.
motifcode.scheduling: One agent; subagents through the task tool.
motifcode.observability: Journal of events, checkpoints and per-request usage; the runner keeps it with the patch and both grades.
motifcode.verification: The done-confirmation challenge; every turn's actions validated against closed schemas before any runs; a loop guard.
motifcode.governance: A home directory of its own per row; streams every request; retries a failed or cut-off request up to six times; the API key is withheld from the commands the agent runs.

motifcode-0.3.0.execution: motifcode 0.3.0 as published on npm, the build the 2026-09-20 campaign ran (v0.3.0, a87dec0). `motif "<task>"` one-shot, in the directory the runner gives it; a task ends only by a `done` call, which is challenged once and must be confirmed; turn limit from the manifest (100). No release before this repository's build can continue a finished session without a terminal, so the feedback round runs v0.3.0 built with a backport of --continue-from (harnesses/motifcode-0.3.0/continue-from.patch); install_harnesses.sh checks that it carries the release's system prompt and tool schemas.
motifcode-0.3.0.tools: done, bash (120 s per command unless the model sets another), read, write, apply_patch, term, skill, task; no MCP servers, no web tools.
motifcode-0.3.0.context: Frozen tool order; the model's reasoning is sent back every turn; compaction at 75% of the 262,144-token window, whose summary request carries no output cap; the output cap per step from the manifest on the loop's and subagents' requests; temperature 1.0 and top_p 0.95 sent with every request.
motifcode-0.3.0.scheduling: One agent; subagents through the task tool.
motifcode-0.3.0.observability: Journal of events, checkpoints and per-request usage; the runner keeps it with the patch and both grades.
motifcode-0.3.0.verification: The done-confirmation challenge; every turn's actions validated against closed schemas before any runs; a loop guard.
motifcode-0.3.0.governance: A home directory of its own per row; streams a request only when its output is a terminal, which in these rows it is not (the endpoint ends a request it has not streamed at 600 s); retries a failed request up to three times; the API key is withheld from the commands the agent runs.

codex.execution: `codex exec` in the row's directory, approvals never, sandbox bypassed; no turn limit; the feedback round is `codex exec resume <thread>`.
codex.tools: What codex-cli 0.154 offers a model it has no metadata for: exec_command (runs in a PTY and answers after 10 s by default; a longer command keeps running in a session the model polls with write_stdin, so there is no command timeout), write_stdin, view_image, multi_agent_v1, get_goal / create_goal / update_goal, request_user_input (Plan mode only); the hosted web search is disabled in config.
codex.context: model_context_window 262,144 (config); Codex's own compaction; the output cap per step from the manifest, temperature 1.0 and top_p 0.95 added to each request by adapters/param_proxy.mjs.
codex.observability: `--json` event log (commands, messages, usage per turn); the parameter proxy logs one line per request with what it added.
codex.governance: A home directory and a CODEX_HOME from a pristine config of its own per row; stream idle timeout raised to 30 minutes; CODEX_STOCK=1 runs Codex without the parameter proxy. At startup codex-cli fetches its curated plugin marketplace (a git fetch, on by default); no plugin is installed.

opencode.execution: `opencode run --pure` in the row's directory, permissions auto-approved; no turn limit; the feedback round is `opencode run --session <id>`.
opencode.tools: OpenCode 1.18's own: bash (120 s per command unless the model sets another), read, edit, write, glob, grep, todowrite, task, skill; webfetch and websearch denied by config.
opencode.context: limit.context 262,144; OpenCode's own compaction; limit.output set to the manifest's cap, and temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95 on each of its agents, in a per-row config.
opencode.scheduling: One agent; subagents through its task tool.
opencode.observability: `--format json` event log (tool calls, tokens per step).
opencode.governance: A home directory and XDG config, data and state directories of its own per row; no external plugins. At startup OpenCode installs its plugin SDK into the per-row config directory.
